profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Software Engineer II at Microsoft working on AI‑driven experiences. I’m a full‑stack engineer who enjoys designing scalable UI architecture and the server‑side systems that support it, with a strong focus on quality, accessibility, and long‑term maintainability.

I’m equally passionate about mentorship and team culture — from supporting students and early‑career engineers to fostering inclusive, high‑trust teams where people can thrive.

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Microsoft AI
positions.description:
- Co‑designed and led the client‑side architecture for Clarity Brand Agents’ AI‑driven UX in partnership with another engineer, translating customer research into reusable UI foundations that improved clarity, consistency, and scalability.
- Drove architectural modernization, removing legacy components and establishing a clean, extensible UI system to support faster iteration and long‑term maintainability.
- Championed engineering excellence and quality, increasing visual regression test coverage from 0% → 72%, stabilizing Playwright E2E tests, and decoupling client PRs from server instability through mock server tooling.
- Enabled rapid feature development at scale, supporting rollout to 500+ live merchants, while building internal tools to diagnose and resolve merchant UI issues impacting customer satisfaction.
- Served as a quality and culture leader, improving security and accessibility posture, raising documentation and testing standards, and fostering an inclusive, high‑trust environment during high‑pressure delivery periods.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Microsoft AI
positions.description:
- Co‑led development of the Clarity Brand Agents frontend in close partnership with a senior engineer, contributing heavily to client architecture, core interaction patterns, styling, and accessibility.
- Executed UX work end‑to‑end, from rapid React prototyping through production‑ready, performance‑optimized, and pixel‑perfect implementations aligned with design specs.
- Took ownership of accessibility and localization initiatives, implementing dark mode, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and a scalable localization framework.
- Partnered with backend engineers to design and implement supporting server infrastructure, including API contracts, dynamic parameters, advertiser customization, and Cosmos DB integrations.
- Contributed to AI‑driven offline pipelines, building a GPT‑4o–powered Python workflow to generate rich, normalized product attributes at scale.

positions.title: Software Engineer, MXP
positions.description:
- Led front‑end development for Skype Clips using React Native and React.js, integrating FluentUI, refactoring the codebase for maintainability, and implementing Jest and Playwright testing.
- Developed promotional banners in the Skype mobile app to upsell Bing as the default search engine, contributing to a 20% conversion rate.
- Shipped multiple monetization experiments for Bing, driving measurable revenue and user engagement gains.
- Initiated and developed a proof‑of‑concept agentic AI commerce demo in Swift using MVVM, integrating the Gmail API and modular UX components.

positions.title: Software Engineer, WebXT
positions.description:
- Drove and shipped multiple end‑to‑end features for Edge Shopping, targeting user delight and retention.
- Led team documentation and onboarding initiatives, including mentoring new team members.
- Extended support for Edge Shopping’s auto‑apply feature to additional countries, increasing overall DAU.
- Resolved performance and accessibility issues in the front‑end repository, standardizing functions and custom FAST components.
- Refactored the UX codebase, optimizing performance and reducing bundle size.

positions.title: SWE Intern — Web XT
positions.description:
- Developed a shopping experience for Bing in which similar competitive products are suggested for a specific product query
- Leveraged data mining and machine learning to extract patterns within product data to curate datasets for the experience
- Final experience affected 0.2% of total pages, brought approx. 1k users to shopping vertical, and triggered a statistically significant increase in customer interaction with shopping features within the first week

positions.title: Explore Intern — Bing AI
positions.description:
- Created a three-step module involving a binary classifier, a conditional random field, and reverse-engineered regex
- Trained a logistic regression learner, achieving an F1 score of 93 through adding and optimizing features for a labelled data set
- Trained a CRF learner to label a tokenized data set, achieving an F1 score of 92
- Wrapped these two machine learning modules and the aforementioned reverse-engineered regex into a library to be called by the team's program

positions.title: Google Student Innovator
positions.description:
- Spearheaded campaign to educate and equip UCLA students with the skills to use Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
- Reached out to faculty and staff to encourage use of GCP in school curriculum

positions.title: Undergraduate Technical Intern
positions.description:
- Created online courses for new users to easily learn how to use Intel FPGAs through a more accessible, dynamic medium
- Developed demos to showcase Intel FPGAs at university outreach events
- Conducted competitive analysis between Intel and its competitors on university presence and provided key insights on improving Intel’s performance

positions.title: Chief Payload Engineer and Avionics Manager
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the design, testing and manufacturing of the payload for UCLA’s all-freshman team competing in the Intercollegiate Rocket Engineering Competition hosted by Spaceport America, which won 2nd place in its category
- Allocated funds and assets according to the project budget and organized asset inventory for the Avionics Subteam
- Mediated disputes, enforced production timeline and facilitated team spirit for the Avionics Subteam

positions.title: Lifeguard and Swim Instructor
positions.description:
- Supervised and enforced swim center safety during lap swim and public swim
- Taught swim lessons to children ages three to twelve
- Inspected swim center facilities for safety and cleanliness

company.name: Hayward Area Parks and Recreaction District

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Mentor college students pursuing careers in technology through a structured, faith‑based mentorship program, offering career guidance and industry perspective.
- Support mentees through regular one‑on‑one conversations focused on professional growth, vocational discernment, and confidence‑building.

- Collaborated with student groups at UCLA such as SWE and IEEE to co-host STEM events with Intel for middle school and high school students
- Connected with high-need schools with underprivileged minorities to engage with students in Intel-hosted science workshops and encourage them to pursue careers in STEM

organizations.name: Grace on Campus Web Team
organizations.description:
- Collaborated alongside other undergraduate students in Grace on Campus, a Christian fellowship, to create an app in order to promote more effective communication within the fellowship and simplify the processes of organizing rides to church using Google Firestore and Javascript
- Improved app based off feedback from users into second iteration of app

organizations.name: Road to Damascus A Cappella
organizations.description:
- Previously held the position of music director from 2019-2020, and was tasked with creating a set list, running rehearsals, and assisting in vocal technique
- Sang as an alto in UCLA's only Christian a cappella group at musical concerts as well as charity events
- Arranged and transcribed several pieces for a cappella performances
- Managed group vision, planned retreats and led leadership meetings
- Maintained RtD's website, ensuring intuitive UI and consistent event updates
